titleEn: Prime Number of Set Bits in Binary Representation
title: 二进制表示中质数个计算置位
summary: 统计闭区间 [left,right] 中，二进制表示里 1 的数量为质数的整数个数。
insight: 32 位正整数的置位数很小，直接计算每个数 bitCount 并用预置质数集合判断即可。
pitfalls: 置位数而非数值本身需要判质数

solutions.title: 置位计数与质数掩码
solutions.idea: 枚举区间并判断固定小范围内的置位数。
steps: value 从 left 到 right 计算 bitCount
若计数在集合中则 answer++，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int countPrimeSetBits(int left,int right){Set<Integer> primes=Set.of(2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19);int answer=0;for(int value=left;value<=right;value++)if(primes.contains(Integer.bitCount(value)))answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countPrimeSetBits(left:Int,right:Int):Int{val primes=setOf(2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19);var answer=0;for(value in left..right)if(Integer.bitCount(value) in primes)answer++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countPrimeSetBits(int left,int right){bool prime[33]{};for(int value:{2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19})prime[value]=true;int answer=0;for(int value=left;value<=right;++value)answer+=prime[__builtin_popcount(value)];return answer;} };
